nameOfQualification: In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) Service Engineering and Maintenance Supervisor
description: This short-term, practical-oriented course will enable learners to understand the fundamentals of medical diagnostics, the operating principles of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) equipment, and its applications, to take up Service Engineer/Technician jobs in the IVD segment of the Medical Devices Sub Sector. To equip learners with industry-relevant skills in mechanical systems, manufacturing processes, automation, regulatory practices, biomedical engineering concepts, and medical electronics, which are crucial for the efficient servicing and maintenance professional to follow guidelines set by production, quality assurance, and field application of In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Multinational Companies (MNC)

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to IVD, Biomedical Instrumentations and Physiological Measurements
Bio-Signal Acquisition and Safety in Biomedical Instrumentation
Analytical Principles and Instruments Used for Clinical Chemistry
Operations of Biomedical Transducers and Sensors in IVD
Internet of Things and Smart Systems for IVDs and Medical Devices
Application Testing of IVDs for Hematology, Immunoassay and Molecular Diagnostics
Medical Device Design Control and Risk Management as per Regulatory Quality Standards and Clinical guidelines for IVDs
Operations and Servicing of Point of Care IVDs
Perform installation, routine maintenance and trouble shooting following the guidelines for IVD component assembly and material handling guidelines
Manage Customer Satisfaction through field service and maintenance operations

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: B. Sc. (Medical Lab technology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, Zoology, Botany Microbiology, Biotechnology, Electronics)
B tech (Biomedical, Electrical and Electronics, Medical Electronics, Electronics and communication, Applied Electronics and Instrumentation)
